name: ปศุสัตว์ Sentinel
idea: Combines farmer photo reports, satellite data and weather to warn of livestock disease spread like lumpy skin.
twist: Farmers report sick cattle by LINE photo; alerts go to the district livestock office with a risk map.
sources: AgroSentinel (4th FAO-CAAS Youth Hackathon on One Health 2025, 3rd prize (New Service Track)) — Satellite-guided early warning system combining remote sensing and AI to monitor antimicrobial resistance and zoonotic disease risk on farms.

name: ทวงดีๆ
idea: An agent collects overdue credit from neighbourhood shops for small wholesalers with polite, staged LINE reminders.
twist: Matches Thai credit culture, offering instalments or PromptPay QR instead of harsh collection.
sources: Claimsio (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — AI-native debt collection service for SMEs that replaces collection agencies with automated soft-collection workflows and factoring.

name: Probe TH
idea: An adversary agent poses as tricky Thai customers and a judge agent scores a bank's AI advisor on thousands of conversations.
twist: Tests Thai-only risks like mixed Thai-English, regional slang and elders who misunderstand loan terms.
sources: Probe (C:\>DIR Global Agentic Regulator Hackathon 2026, 6th place, Cambridge UK) — Uses an adversary agent posing as customers and a judge agent to run thousands of test conversations against AI financial advice systems.

name: Agent Wallet Mandate
idea: Users give their shopping agents a ShopeePay mandate with limits, and every agent payment is checked before execution.
twist: Family mandates let parents cap a teen's game top-ups or an elder's purchases with clear Thai receipts.
sources: Legis Labs Agent Passport (C:\>DIR Global Agentic Regulator Hackathon 2026, vouch.finance Award, Cambridge UK) — Agent passport that lets banks validate AI-agent payment authority before execution.

name: Parcel Pre-Load Check
idea: Scans parcel declarations before loading and flags risky items like lithium batteries or banned goods.
twist: Reads vague Thai item descriptions like 'ของใช้' against seller history to choose which parcels get inspected.
sources: PLACI (KaiTETHON 2026 (Kale Logistics Solutions), overall winner, Mumbai) — AI pre-loading cargo risk analyst that analyses advance cargo information to flag risks before loading.

name: ลายมือบอก Dyslexia
idea: Screens handwriting samples for dyslexia signs and gives teachers tailored lesson plans.
twist: Tuned for Thai script errors like tone-mark and vowel placement, which English dyslexia tools miss.
sources: Dyscover (Wharton Hack-AI-thon 2025, 1st place AI for Education, Philadelphia) — Analyses handwriting samples to detect signs of dyslexia and generates tailored lesson plans for teachers via a GPT-4 chatbot.

name: ไลฟ์ภาษามือ
idea: Adds a Thai Sign Language avatar and live captions to Shopee Live so deaf buyers can follow and ask questions.
twist: Deaf viewers can sign questions back to the host, translated into Thai text in the chat.
sources: Signity (Microsoft ASEAN AI for Accessibility Hackathon 2025, Champion (UTP regional), Malaysia) — AI sign language translation app that integrates into platforms like TikTok and Shopee for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
Silentalk (Inter-University GenAI Hackathon for the SDGs 2025, Silver, Hong Kong) — AI sign language interpreter.

name: ป่าชายเลน Watch
idea: Uses satellite images to detect coastal erosion and mangrove loss and alerts local councils with risk maps.
twist: Ranks Thai coastal tambons by erosion speed and drafts the อบต. budget request with evidence.
sources: EcoGuardian.AI (AI x City Climate Action Hackathon 2025 (Global Covenant of Mayors), winner, Climate Week NYC) — Uses AI, GIS and remote sensing to detect land degradation in real time and produce risk maps and alerts for cities.

name: TCAS Essay Coach
idea: Grades Thai university admission essays and writing answers and builds a personal study plan and mock exams.
twist: Follows Thai writing rubrics and gives rural students without tutors the same feedback loop.
sources: Edu.AI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), Latin America winner) — Multi-agent educational system for Brazil that evaluates essays, generates personalized study plans and creates interdisciplinary mock exams.
ไอจารย์ (AI Thailand Hackathon 2025 🇹🇭, commendation)

name: ประกันคุ้มไหม
idea: Reasons through a health insurance policy for a specific scenario and asks follow-up questions before saying covered or not.
twist: Turns Thai policy PDFs into machine-readable rules so buyers compare plans on Shopee before buying.
sources: The Hammurabi (Stanford LLM x Law Hackathon Fall 2024, Best VC, Stanford) — AI platform that reasons through insurance contract logic to determine outcomes for specific scenarios, asking clarifying questions before concluding.

ActuaViz (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — Converts complex insurance product documents into machine-readable formats to automate product comparison, chatbot support and pricing simulation.

name: ตรวจเรียงความ · Thai essay grader
idea: Grades Thai secondary-school summaries and essays against the teacher's own rubric, quoting the rubric line behind every point given or lost.
twist: Flags borderline scripts for teacher moderation and builds each student's remedial exercise from their actual errors.
sources: Edu.AI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), Latin America winner) — Multi-agent educational system for Brazil that evaluates essays, generates personalized study plans and creates interdisciplinary mock exams.

name: อ่านออกเขียนได้ Screener
idea: Analyses Prathom 1–3 Thai handwriting and dictation for letter reversals, tone-mark and vowel-position errors that may signal dyslexia.
twist: Drafts the learning-support section of an individual education plan (IEP) for the school's special-education coordinator to review.
sources: Dyscover (Wharton Hack-AI-thon 2025, 1st place AI for Education, Philadelphia) — Analyses handwriting samples to detect signs of dyslexia and generates tailored lesson plans for teachers via a GPT-4 chatbot.

name: SAR Evidence Builder
idea: Compiles a school's annual Self-Assessment Report (SAR) from lesson plans, test results and activity records, organised by the school's quality standards.
twist: Links every claim to a piece of evidence and flags unsupported claims before external quality assessors visit.
sources: Apollo (Microsoft AI Agents Hackathon 2025 (virtual), Best C# Agent) — Deep research assistant that turns complex queries into comprehensive reports through multi-agent orchestration.
Konveyor (Microsoft AI Agents Hackathon 2025 (virtual), Best Python Agent) — Knowledge transfer agent that conveys organizational knowledge from where it resides to where it is needed.

name: ห้องเรียนคละชั้น · multi-grade planner
idea: An offline lesson server for small rural schools where one teacher covers several grades, mapped to Basic Education Core Curriculum indicators.
twist: Plans a single lesson period in which each grade works on its own indicator at the same time.
sources: LENTERA (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), Ollama Prize) — Offline educational microserver on affordable hardware for remote and disconnected rural regions.

name: Graduation Audit for registrars
idea: Checks a university student's transcript against the programme's curriculum structure and tells the registrar whether they can graduate.
twist: Explains missing credits and suggests which open courses next semester actually satisfy each unmet requirement.
sources: RaoChatHub (Super AI Engineer Season 5 (AI Innovator Track) 2025, Thailand, 1st (Eastern center)) — Chatbot platform that answers from real databases and uploaded documents, reads images with vision AI, and unifies Facebook, Instagram and LINE messages; deployed for 24/7 student Q&A at Burapha University.
